label: Content creation
summary: A newsletter, blog, channel or social presence with a rhythm. Briefs before drafts, sources behind facts, one calendar. The assistant drafts and never publishes.

first_phase.title: Editorial baseline: audience, voice, pillars, calendar

questions.ask: Where it is published: newsletter, blog, YouTube, LinkedIn, podcast, other. One line.
Who it is for, in one line, and what they should get from it.
The rhythm you commit to: pieces per week or month, and the day if fixed.

phases.title: Editorial baseline: audience, voice, pillars, calendar
First four pieces: brief, draft, review, ready
The rhythm holds: one session per piece, calendar four weeks ahead
What worked: measured per piece, pillars adjusted
